{
  "name": "tamirs-superpowers",
  "displayName": "Tamir's Superpowers",
  "version": "5.0.1",
  "description": "30 bundled skills, 10 specialist agents, smart worktree hooks, statusline, and MCP server stubs — plan, implement, review, debug, multi-agent setup, and audit code from one plugin.",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers/blob/master/docs/user/install/claude-code.md",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers/blob/master/PRIVACY.md",
  "author": {
    "name": "Tamir Cohen",
    "url": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "skills",
    "hooks",
    "developer-tools",
    "mcp",
    "claude-code",
    "worktree",
    "workflow"
  ],
  "icon": "./listing/icon.png",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./mod/types/index.d.ts",
  "defaultEnabled": true,
  "mcpServers": "./.mcp.json",
  "skills": [
    "./skills/creative",
    "./skills/debugging",
    "./skills/dev-workflow",
    "./skills/documentation",
    "./skills/mcp",
    "./skills/toolkit",
    "./skills/repo"
  ],
  "settings": {
    "statusLine": {
      "type": "command",
      "command": "s=\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/scripts/statusline.sh\"; [ -f \"$s\" ] || s=$(ls $HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/tamirs-marketplace/tamirs-superpowers/*/scripts/statusline.sh 2>/dev/null | sort -rV | head -1); [ -n \"$s\" ] && [ -f \"$s\" ] && bash \"$s\""
    }
  },
  "userConfig": {
    "github_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "GitHub token for the bundled github MCP server",
      "description": "Optional. A GitHub personal access token with repo scope (the gh CLI can print its own). Leave blank to keep the github MCP server off - it refuses to start without one and nothing else needs it.",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "pushover_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pushover application token",
      "description": "Optional. From your Pushover application at pushover.net/apps. Leave blank to keep phone notifications off - the notification hook stays silent when unconfigured.",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "pushover_user": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pushover user key",
      "description": "Optional. Your Pushover user key from pushover.net. Required only if you set an application token above. Read by the Notification hook only; the mod sends nothing.",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "rate_limit_warn_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Rate-limit warning threshold (%)",
      "description": "The mod shows a band above the prompt with a handoff reminder once any rate-limit window (5h, 7d, spend) reaches this percentage. Claude Code and Claude Desktop only.",
      "default": 85,
      "min": 50,
      "max": 100
    },
    "semantic_skill_suggest": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Semantic skill suggestions (one small-model call per long prompt)",
      "description": "Off by default. When on, prompts of 12+ words are classified by a small model against the bundled skill names and a matching skill is named to Claude as context. hooks/skill-suggest.sh's keyword matching stays on either way.",
      "default": false
    },
    "notification_hooks": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Notification hooks (desktop and phone notifications, VPN exit check, usage-capture collector start)",
      "description": "On by default. When off, the desktop notification, the Pushover phone notification, the VPN exit-node check and the usage-capture collector start stay silent, whatever else is configured. Safety, worktree and convenience hooks are unaffected. Read by the bash hooks only; hosts without plugin options use the default.",
      "default": true
    },
    "contributor_hooks": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Contributor hooks (plugin-author reminders and checks)",
      "description": "Off by default. When on, the /reload-plugins reminder after a plugin-file edit, report.md link validation and the hand-written SKILL.md guard run. For people working on this plugin or on agent configuration; noise for everyone else. Read by the bash hooks only; hosts without plugin options use the default.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
